title: Redundant Connection
prompt: In this problem, a tree is an undirected graph that is connected and has no cycles. You are given a graph that started as a tree with n nodes labeled from 1 to n, with one additional edge added. The added edge has two different vertices chosen from 1 to n. Return an edge that can be removed so that the resulting graph is a tree of n nodes. If there are multiple answers, return the answer that occurs last in the input.
hints: Union-Find: for each edge (u,v), if u and v are already in the same component, this edge creates a cycle - return it.
Iterate edges in order. Union u and v. If find(u) == find(v) before union, that edge is redundant.
1-indexed nodes. Parent array of size n+1.
